cases.text:
Doorway
The first room names the mother.

Threshold
The second room repeats her name as a question.

Exit
The last room removes the name; reversing these rooms breaks the staged loss.
cases.grounding: reversing these rooms breaks the staged loss

cases.text:
A thin page of rain opens the poem.

Nine long pages inventory drought.

One thin page of rain returns; shrinking the drought section destroys the drought-to-return proportion.
cases.grounding: shrinking the drought section destroys the drought-to-return proportion

cases.text:
Before the siren: a blue cup waits.

During the siren: the cup is carried downstairs.

After the siren: the blue cup is empty; moving the recurrence changes its before-during-after frame.
cases.grounding: moving the recurrence changes its before-during-after frame

cases.text:
A child counts moths at the window.

Immediately beside it, an adult lists unpaid hospital bills.

The adjacency makes each count answer the other; separating them weakens that relation.
cases.grounding: The adjacency makes each count answer the other

cases.text:
The first two stanzas describe rain with unrelated images.

The final stanza says, 'I forgive the rain.'

The ending is affecting, but no relation among the earlier parts depends on their order or scale.
cases.grounding: no relation among the earlier parts depends on their order or scale

cases.text:
A speaker wakes, walks to work, and returns home.

The sequence is chronological, but the parts can be reordered without changing a structural relation among them.
cases.grounding: can be reordered without changing a structural relation

cases.text:
One stanza is bright and one stanza is dark.

They contrast, yet nothing in their placement, recurrence, or proportion makes the contrast structurally necessary.
cases.grounding: nothing in their placement, recurrence, or proportion makes the contrast structurally necessary

cases.text:
Each stanza has exact internal rhyme and a sharp turn.

The stanzas are otherwise interchangeable, with no poem-wide relation dependent on their placement or scale.
cases.grounding: stanzas are otherwise interchangeable

cases.text: One uninterrupted twelve-line meditation on a kettle cooling on a stove.
cases.grounding: One uninterrupted

cases.text: This lone stanza repeats a birdcall and ends with a question.
cases.grounding: lone stanza

cases.text: Page two begins in the middle of a refrain and stops before the next section arrives.
cases.grounding: Page two begins

cases.text:
[Opening and closing pages unavailable.]

A middle stanza names an empty station.
cases.grounding: Opening and closing pages unavailable

cases.text:
The poem begins with a map folded shut.

Its center loses every street name.

It ends with the map opened blank; the frame depends on this placement.
cases.grounding: frame depends on this placement

cases.text:
First, a father teaches a daughter one word.

Next, she misuses it in a letter.

Finally, he recognizes the mistake; reordering breaks the teaching-to-recognition relation.
cases.grounding: reordering breaks the teaching-to-recognition relation

cases.text:
A short invocation is followed by a deliberately overwhelming catalog of names, then a short silence.

The imbalance is the invocation-catalog-silence architecture; equalizing the parts weakens it.
cases.grounding: equalizing the parts weakens it

cases.text:
Three unrelated images appear: a coin, a dog, a ladder.

A final line says, 'Now I understand.'

That ending alone supplies no material relation among the parts.
cases.grounding: ending alone supplies no material relation

cases.text:
Morning becomes afternoon, then evening.

The chronology reads smoothly, but no placement-sensitive relationship among major parts is evidenced.
cases.grounding: no placement-sensitive relationship among major parts is evidenced

cases.text:
A warm room follows a cold room.

The opposition is clear, but swapping the rooms would not weaken a specific poem-wide architecture.
cases.grounding: swapping the rooms would not weaken a specific poem-wide architecture

cases.text: A single unsegmented lyric watches dust cross one afternoon window.
cases.grounding: single unsegmented lyric

cases.text: Only the middle section is supplied, and the document gives no confirmation that it is complete.
cases.grounding: Only the middle section is supplied
